projectDescription: An all-in-one job application management workbench that helps job seekers track applications, match resumes to job descriptions, and prepare for interviews throughout the recruitment season.
keyFeatures: Kanban-style application tracker with status pipeline (Applied → Written Test → Interview → Offer)
Multi-version resume management with AI-powered scoring and optimization
JD matching with radar chart analysis and skills gap identification
Interview preparation with question prediction, mock sessions, and AI feedback
Offer evaluation with multi-dimensional scoring (salary, growth, culture)
AI assistant (floating chat) available across all modules
Data dashboard with application funnel statistics and analytics
Calendar view for deadlines and interview schedules
Local-first data storage — all data stays on the user's device
publicApiSurface: Application status pipeline: Pending → Applied → Written Test → Interview → Offer → Closed
Resume upload (PDF / Word / Markdown / plain text)
JD paste-and-match: resume vs. job description fit scoring
AI resume optimizer: keyword alignment, STAR rewrites
Interview question generator based on JD
Mock interview session with AI feedback
Offer scorer: salary, growth potential, workload, benefits, brand
AI chat assistant with resume / JD / interview context
DeepSeek / GLM / other OpenAI-compatible API key configuration
